RAJYA SABHA

List of Questions for ORAL  ANSWERS
to be asked at a sitting of the Rajya Sabha to be held on
Tuesday, the December 7, 2004/Agrahayana 16, 1926 (Saka)
————
(Ministries: Civil Aviation; Company Affairs; Finance; Panchayati Raj;
Petroluem and Natural Gas; Tourism; Water Resources)
Total number of questions — 20
†Original notice of the question received in Hindi.
Production of Methane gas
*81. SHRIMATI PREMA CARIAPPA:
Will the Minister of PETROLEUM AND
NATURAL GAS be pleased to state:
(a) whether Government have
formulated any policy for exploration and
production of Methane gas from coal
seams, wastes of landfill and gas and oil
systems in the country;
(b) if so, the details thereof; and
(c) the quantum of Methane produced
during the last two years in the country,
year-wise and State-wise?
Installation of CCTV camera at
airports
†*82. SHRIMATI. SAVITA SHARDA:
Will the Minister of CIVIL AVIATION be
pleased to state:
(a) whether Government propose to
instal close circuit TV cameras in the
internal areas of the domestic as well as
International Airports in order to prevent
day-to-day incidents of fraud and crime
taking place at these airports;
(b) if so, the details thereof;
(c) by when, a final decision is likely to
be taken in this regard; and
(d) the estimated cost of the project?
Aviation agreement with UK
*83. SHRI ANAND SHARMA: Will
the Minister of CIVIL AVIATION be
pleased to state:
(a) whether an agreement has been
signed with Government and Aviation
authorities of UK for increasing the
frequency of flights by Indian carriers to
the United Kingdom; and
(b) if so, the details of the agreement
and the steps taken for its implementation
by Air India and other concerned agencies?

26
Curtailment in Government posts and
expenditure
†*84. SHRI MOTILAL VORA: Will
the Minister of FINANCE be pleased to
state:
(a) whether his Ministry has suggested
the Ministries/Departments to curtail the
number of Government posts and
expenditure in the light of
recommendations made by the Expenditure
Reform Committee;
(b) if so, the details thereof;
(c) the reaction of concerned Ministries/
Departments on the suggestion of his
Ministry; and
(d) by when, the curtailment is likely
to be effected?
Review of energy security
*85. SHRI R. P. GOENKA: Will the
Minister of PETROLEUM AND
NATURAL GAS be pleased to state:
(a) whether Government have reviewed
the escalating threats to energy security of
the country posed especially by the
emerging problems of crude oil shortage
and high prices;
(b) if so, the details of intensive studies
undertaken, if any, and the holistic policy
and alternative solutions worked out;
(c) whether Government have also
reviewed the proceedings of the Peak Oil
Conference held recently in Berlin, wherein
the Association for the Study of Peak Oil
has made some grim predictions, on the
diminishing world oil reserves and the
rising price of crude, reaching phenomenal
$ 182 a barrel; and
(d) if so, the reaction of Government
thereto?
Outstanding foreign debt
†*86. SHRIMATI. KUM KUM RAI:
Will the Minister of FINANCE be pleased
to state:
(a) the total foreign debt outstanding
against the country in exclusive terms
alongwith its percentage in the GDP;
(b) whether there has been any increase
or decrease in the said debt during the last
three years; and
(c) the total external debt owed to the
country based on this ratio during the last
three years?
Channellisation of Swan river in
Himachal Pradesh
†*87. SHRI KRIPAL PARMAR: Will
the Minister of WATER RESOURCES be
pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that the
Government of Himachal Pradesh had on
the 4th March, 2002 submitted a proposal
of Rs. 123.93 crores for 16.67 km. long
Channellisation of river swan in the Una
district of Himachal Pradesh from Jhalera
bridge to Santokhgarh bridge after its
approval by Planning Commission and
financial and administrative sanction by the
Himachal Pradesh Government for
providing financial assistance for the same;
(b) if so, the details of action taken
thereon and reasons for keeping the said
matter pending till now; and
(c) by when a final decision is likely to
be taken in this regard?
Supply of gas to Andhra Pradesh
*88. SHRI RAMA MUNI REDDY
SIRIGIREDDY: Will the Minister of
PETROLEUM AND NATURAL GAS be
pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that the

Government of Andhra Pradesh has
approached his Ministry for restoration of
full gas supplies to four independent power
producers in the State;
(b) if so, when the proposal/request was
received in his Ministry;
(c) the details of GAIL’s allocation of
gas to the State of Andhra Pradesh for
various projects during the last three years,
year-wise; and
(d) the details of demand made by the
Government of Andhra Pradesh for supply
of gas during the last three years, year-
wise?
Panchayati Raj institutions in J&K

(a) whether G

RAJYA SABHA
————
List of Questions for WRITTEN  ANSWERS
to be asked at a sitting of the Rajya Sabha to be held on
Tuesday, the December 7, 2004/Agrahayana 16, 1926 (Saka)
————
(Ministries: Civil Aviation; Company Affairs; Finance; Panchayati Raj;
Petroleum and Natural Gas; Tourism; Water Resources)
Total number of questions — 138
New destinations of Air India
433. SHRIMATI S.G. INDIRA: Will
the Minister of CIVIL AVIATION be
pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that Air India is
working out a composite proposal for
fleet acquisition at an estimated cost of
Rs. 20,000 crores;
(b) whether it is also a fact that Air India
will require eighteen aircrafts for Air India
Express to be launched in April, 2005;
(c) whether it is also a fact that the Air
India plans for flying to new destinations;
and
(d) if so, the details thereof?
Airport Economic Regulatory Authority
434. SHRI LALIT SURI: Will the
Minister of CIVIL AVIATION be pleased
to state:
(a) whether Government propose to
constitute Airport Economic Regulatory
Authority;
(b) if so, what would be its composition
and the main functions proposed to be
assigned to it; and
(c) by when it is likely to start
functioning?
Air service between Kanpur and Delhi
435. PROF. M.M. AGARWAL: Will the
Minister of CIVIL AVIATION be pleased
to refer to answer to Unstarred Question
143 given in the Rajya Sabha on 22nd July,
2003 and state:
(a) the steps taken by Government to
operate daily flight services between
Kanpur and Delhi and vice-versa so far;
and
(b) by when it is likely to be started?
Aviation disaster near Mumbai
436. SHRIMATI S.G. INDIRA: Will
the Minister of CIVIL AVIATION be
pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that a major
aviation disaster involving three scheduled
passenger airlines was averted 100 nautical
miles north east of Mumbai on the night of
September 23, 2004;
(b) whether it is also a fact that all the
three planes were one above the other and

97
appeared as a single radar position symbol
on the radar screen;
(c) if so, whether any enquiry has been
ordered in this regard; and
(d) if so, the details thereof?
Revision of air fare
437. SHRI RAJEEV SHUKLA:
SHRI MURLI DEORA:
Will the Minister of CIVIL AVIATION
be pleased to state:
(a) whether airlines in India have
decided to increase air fares and if so, the
details thereof;
(b) whether the air fares in India are
three times more than elsewhere in the
world and if so, the reasons therefor;
(c) whether Air Turbine Fuel is more
expensive here as 80 per cent excise tax
coupled with state sales tax ranging from
4 per cent to 9 per cent is imposed on it
and if so, the reasons therefor; and
(d) whether Government propose to
look into the matter and bring parity in fares
with airlines of other countries?
Swagat Seva at international airports
438. SHRI DATTA MEGHE:
SHRI B.J. PANDA:
Will the Minister of CIVIL AVIATION
be pleased to state:
(a) the details of the customer-friendly
“Swagat Seva” service which would
provide hassle-free transit to passengers at
international airports;
(b) whether such a service is also
available in other countries, and if so, the
details thereof; and
(c) whether it is a payment-based
service and if so, the cost thereof?
International airport at Nagpur
439. SHRI VIJAY J. DARDA: Will the
Minister of CIVIL AVIATION be pleased
to refer to answer to Starred Question 24
and Unstarred Question 239 given in the
Rajya Sabha on 6th July and 13th July,
2004 respectively and state:
(a) what is the present status of the
proposal to develop a multi-nodal
international hub airport for passenger and
cargo at Nagpur;
(b) the broad features of the
contemplated international airport;
(c) whether the area around is to be
developed into a Special Economic Zone
to boost up exports as a part of the plan;
and
(d) the progress made so far and what
is the time-frame for completion?
Facilities for Haj pilgrims
440. SHRI MUKHTAR ABBAS
NAQVI: Will the Minister of CIVIL
AVIATION be pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that only Air India
and Saudi Airlines are being used for
carrying Haj pilgrims at present;
(b) whether it is also a fact that there
are complaints against Saudi Airlines for
not providing proper services to the Haj
pilgrims;
(c) whether Government have any
scheme to tie-up with other airlines for
carrying Haj pilgrims so that inconvenience
could be avoided; and
(d) if so, the details thereof?
International carriers to Indian
destinations
441. PROF. ALKA BALRAM
KSHATRIYA: Will the Minister of CIVIL
AVIATION be pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that more than
forty international carriers have shown

98
interest to fly to India during the next one
year;
(b) if so, the names of the airlines which
have shown interest to fly to Indian
destinations; and
(c) whether Indian Airlines and Air
India are planning to reduce their air fares
between Delhi and USA, UK, Europe and
South East Asian countries in view of
competition and if so, the details thereof?
